headline: Proposed $73,075 van purchase and $120,780 speech contract; FY28 budget increase estimated at 7%.
summary: Officials discussed a 15-passenger van for CTE programs, two contracts for special education staffing, and the FY28 budget outlook. The minutes record motions on the van and contracts but no vote results. The FY27 October transfer report was approved 3-0.
decisions: Approved the FY27 October transfer report, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY27 October Transfer Report. Motion passes 3-0.

FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 9, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Finance and Operations Committee was held at NHS North on Monday, November 9, 
2026.  Ms. Lamphier called the meeting to order at 4:31 pm. 
 
Present:  Ms. Lamphier, Ms. Lewis, Mr. Salvi, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present:  Ms. De Gray, Ms. Talbott, and Mr. Beer 
 
Also Present:  Members of the Public, Channel 22 Videographer 
 
CTE 
• Proposed a 15-passenger van for CTE programs to improve access to work-based learning and 
reduce reliance on buses. 
• Discussed funding, expected usage, driver qualifications, insurance, operating costs, and a 
possible second van in FY28. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the purchase of a 15-passenger van from 
Grappone Ford for use in the CTE programs in an amount not to exceed $73,075.00.  Funding to come 
from the CTE Special Revenue account. 
 
Special Education Contracts 
• Reviewed Champion Speech Therapy speech-language staffing for McCarthy Middle School’s 
alternative program. 
• Discussed vendor counts, contractor rates, school assignments, staffing needs, and options for 
improving recruitment. 
• The committee posed several questions regarding the hiring and recruiting practices of the 
District.  The concern being the number of contracted personnel vs. direct hires. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Champion Speech Therapy 
for speech services at McCarthy Middle School Alternative Program during the 2026-2027 school year 
at a cost not to exceed $120,780.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-
District Tuition. 
 
• Reviewed a Blazer Works behavioral technician contract for up to $45,250. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the contract with BlazerWorks LLC for 
staffing of 1.0 FTE BT for the 2026-2027 school year at a total cost not to exceed $45,250.00. Funding 
to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. 
 
 
Transfer Reports 
• Reviewed and approved the FY27 October transfer report. 
• Discussed moving wage funds into contract services for unfilled positions, the higher cost of 
contracted staff, and challenges tracking position-level budgets.
FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING  November 9, 2026 
2 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY27 October Transfer Report.  Motion 
passes 3-0. 
 
FY28 Budget Outlook (high level) 
• Heard a preliminary estimate of a 7% increase, approximately $9.9 million before benefits, with 
major assumptions for benefits, labor, utilities, transportation, tuition, and special education 
services. 
• Reviewed possible budget reductions, staffing impacts, school consolidation considerations, 
adequacy aid, and potential effects on Medicaid-related reimbursements. 
• Discussed the need for state-level funding advocacy and additional analysis of recruitment. 
 
 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to adjourn at 6:12 pm.  Motion passes 3-0. 
 
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
